title: Oblivion
description: Whenever you play a card, this enemy gains [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Doom[/gold].
smart_description: Whenever you play a card, this enemy gains [blue]{Amount}[/blue] [gold]Doom[/gold].
notes: Applies Doom equal to the power's stack count for each card played. The power is instanced per applier and removes itself at the end of the player's turn.
